# Data and analytics

Applies when the change touches: pipelines, warehouses, schemas, ML data. Every role loads this pack for the steps it works in, on top of its own playbook. The test commands below are best practices the gate runs: put them in the Spec's `[[tests.commands]]`, so a red one blocks the merge. Name the pack in the Spec's Context; it does not count against a Task's `skills`.

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item |
| --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd next`) | A schema, contract, or migration change is major (`baseline:migrations`); name the producers and consumers. |
| Specify | The data contract change (ODCS) is written before Spec approval and listed in `design.files`; quality rules (accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness) as tests; retention and deletion for personal data. |
| Specify | The migration plan in expand and contract steps, with a tested rollback and a backfill estimate. |
| Implement | Idempotent, restartable jobs; lineage emitted (OpenLineage); no personal data in fixtures or logs. |
| Review | Query plans for new queries and indexes; the down migration runs on production-shaped data. |
| Ship | Row counts, freshness, and null rates are the observe signals; consumers are notified. |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Contract validation (emerging) | producers and consumers pass the contract | datacontract-cli tests in CI |
| Data quality tests | the quality rules hold on the output | Great Expectations, dbt tests, or Soda checks |
| Migration up and down | the migration and its rollback run on a production-shaped snapshot | the repo's migration tool in the test commands |
| Lineage check | the changed job emits lineage | an OpenLineage test backend |
| PII scan (fixtures and tables) | no personal data in fixtures or outputs | Presidio or a regex scanner |

## Keep it current

A standard marked emerging is a draft, a first edition, or a young practice: apply it only when the change clearly needs it, and say so in the Spec. A standard checked more than a year ago is stale: `aidd eval standards` lists it, and the loop contract's research-first rule applies. When the change needs a standard this pack lacks, look up the authoritative source, record the edition in the Spec's Context, and propose the update to the aidd project's roles registry (`schemas/roles.json` in the aidd repository) as an improvement.
